The repeated-color Rayleigh witness gives lambda_max(H)>=C_k/4~k^(3/2)/(3 sqrt(2pi)). Every NORMALIZED positive sigma^(1/2)[I-tH+f(Q)]sigma^(1/2), t>=0 and real charge-only f, necessarily obeys t C_k<=4. Thus t proportional to b forces k=O(b^(-2/3)); the new k~1/[b ln(1/b)] cannot come merely from improving the positivity estimate of that family. An unnormalized scalar repair does not evade this after normalization. This does not determine sharp extreme-spectrum order, exclude other input directions or imply a capacity converse; the Rayleigh vector is not a high-entropy coding input.

Its bound is min{2,4e_n+2 sqrt(1-Tr(P_(<=A_n)tau))}; half-diamond is exactly half. Only at actual tau_pi is repeated-block coherent information also proved to converge to S(rho)/k. Beta, k and rho are fixed before the outer horizon; all nk calls/outcomes/registers count on one evolving bath, without access/reset/fresh bath, postselection or terminal return.
